channel.name: racquet
channel.topic:
**Racquet** by Greg Davill: a multicore RISC-V SoC built from [SERV](https://github.com/olofk/serv) cores, with chips on wafer.space runs.

**Run 1**
• [GD02](https://wafer.space/ws-run1/projects/GD02.html) (9 cores, 0.5x1 slot)
• [GD03](https://wafer.space/ws-run1/projects/GD03.html) (23 cores, 1x1 slot)
• [GD04](https://wafer.space/ws-run1/projects/GD04.html) (6 cores, 1x0.5 slot)
**Run 2**
• [GD04](https://wafer.space/ws-run2/projects/GD04.html) (6 cores, 1x0.5 slot)
**Source**
• [gf180mcu-racquet](https://github.com/gregdavill/gf180mcu-racquet)
• [gf180mcu-racquet-0.5x1](https://github.com/gregdavill/gf180mcu-racquet-0.5x1)
• [gf180mcu-racquet-1x0.5](https://github.com/gregdavill/gf180mcu-racquet-1x0.5)
• [SERV](https://github.com/olofk/serv), the CPU core
